readme: Catalog connectors that cannot connect through OAuth self-registration from a hosted Opengeni deployment.
Keyed by exact canonical MCP URL, like curated.json, but listing a row here neither curates nor promotes it.
Each entry names the OAuth authorization-server issuer whose operator-registered client the deployment needs.
The catalog offers the connector (Featured, Browse and embedded discovery) only when
OPENGENI_INTEGRATIONS_OAUTH_CLIENTS_JSON has a client for that issuer. Rows not listed here are assumed to
self-register (dynamic client registration or a Client ID Metadata Document), which is the OAuth start default.
reason: no_self_registration = metadata advertises neither DCR nor CIMD; registration_refused = the
registration endpoint refuses unknown clients; redirect_uri_not_allowed = registration or authorization rejects
a deployment callback that the provider has not allowlisted.
To re-offer a connector: register an OAuth client with the provider (redirect URI
under the issuer below. Remove an entry only when the provider's own metadata or registration behavior changes;
Gmail and the hosted Slack MCP are omitted: their native Connect readiness already gates them.
